### David Laments Absalom’s Death
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/david-laments-absaloms-death
Passage: 2 Samuel 18:19-33
Points:
- David struggled with blind spots and indulgence concerning the sins of his children.
- Because of Absalom's unyielding rebellion, the kingdom could only be preserved through his defeat.
- Joab dispatched messengers to report the battle, leading to David's sorrowful cry.
- David's failure to discipline his son serves as a cautionary tale for parents.
- Personal affections must never cloud our judgment regarding rebellion against God-given authority.

### Bible Pathway - April 17
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-april-17-2013.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 18:33
Points:
- Absalom's rebellion and dishonor toward his father ultimately cost him his life.
- David's deep love for his son caused him to wish he had died instead.
- Grieving the death of a loved one is particularly agonizing when relational estrangement exists.
- Believers should resolve interpersonal conflicts daily rather than letting anger linger.
- Christians are encouraged to share the gospel promptly while people are still alive to respond.
